# Infrastructure Monitoring: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation for the installed version. Defaults, option names, and menu
paths change between releases. Re-verify links and contents when updating this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-31

## Vendor (authoritative)

### Prometheus

- Security model (unauthenticated endpoints, admin and lifecycle flags, exporters, Alertmanager CORS,
  Pushgateway): https://prometheus.io/docs/operating/security/
- HTTPS and authentication (web configuration file): https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/https/
- Feature flags (remote-write receiver and others, by version): https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/feature_flags/
- node_exporter (collectors, textfile collector, TLS support): https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter
- Alertmanager: https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager
- Default port allocations for exporters: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/wiki/Default-port-allocations

### Netdata

- Securing Netdata Agents (bind address, access lists, bearer-token protection, disabling the
  dashboard): https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/securing-netdata-agents/
- Streaming configuration reference (`stream.conf`, API keys, `allow from`, TLS):
  https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/metrics-streaming-and-replication/streaming-configuration-reference
- Netdata security advisories: https://github.com/netdata/netdata/security

### Zabbix

- Life cycle and release policy (LTS and standard support dates): https://www.zabbix.com/life_cycle_and_release_policy
- Security advisories: https://www.zabbix.com/security_advisories
- Frontend login (default credentials, login blocking): https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/quickstart/login
- Encryption (PSK and certificates): https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/encryption
- Restricting agent checks (`AllowKey`, `DenyKey`, `system.run`): https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/current/en/manual/config/items/restrict_checks

### Checkmk

- Linux agent (agent controller, TLS registration, legacy mode): https://docs.checkmk.com/latest/en/agent_linux.html
- Windows agent (port 6556 open and unencrypted until registration): https://docs.checkmk.com/latest/en/agent_windows.html
- Users, roles, and permissions (automation users, two-factor authentication): https://docs.checkmk.com/latest/en/wato_user.html
- Security overview: https://docs.checkmk.com/latest/en/security.html
- Werk 7643 (initial admin `cmkadmin` with a randomized password): https://checkmk.com/werk/7643
- Werks (change log, including security fixes): https://checkmk.com/werks

Generic vulnerability and incident sources (CISA KEV, NVD, CVE, CISA ransomware guidance, IC3) are listed in
the core documents.
